security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting, repository-relative links, or marketing audit language rather than executable shell commands, arbitrary path traversal, or system reconnaissance. One network finding is confirmed because the skill can fetch mutable reference instructions from GitHub at runtime, and one semantic privacy finding covers persistent memory writes for account audit results.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle required runbooks with the skill or pin external references to a reviewed commit hash instead of the main branch.
Ask before saving, minimize stored data, and redact account identifiers, order IDs, revenue details, and customer information.

remediation.issue: Parent-directory reference links create noisy security signals
remediation.suggestion: Package referenced documentation inside the skill folder or document exactly which reviewed files the agent may read.

content.user_title: Audit Paid Ad Accounts Before Scaling
content.value_statement: Scaling paid media without checking tracking, audience quality, and waste can hide serious ROAS problems. This skill turns exported account data into a scored audit, veto checks, and a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK decision.
actual_capabilities: Scores Return, Offer, Audience, and Spend-efficiency from exported ad and analytics data.
Checks five veto conditions for tracking, attribution, claims, policy, and placement safety.
Computes goal-weighted RQS for direct response or prospecting goals.
Produces a SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK verdict before budget increases.
Creates an auditor handoff with findings, evidence summary, scores, and next steps.
limitations: Requires user-provided exports and cannot fully audit missing data.
Does not build campaigns, creatives, tracking, or attribution workbooks.
Uses provisional ROAS bands until more real account audits calibrate them.
Does not replace legal, platform policy, or finance review.

use_cases.title: Pre-Scale Budget Check
use_cases.description: Review exported ad data before increasing spend and identify tracking, waste, or placement risks.

use_cases.title: Measurement Integrity Review
use_cases.description: Check conversion tracking, attribution overlap, and ecommerce truth sets before trusting ROAS numbers.

use_cases.title: Client Audit Handoff
use_cases.description: Prepare a structured audit summary with evidence, risks, and next actions for client review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Scale Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this paid ad account before scaling. Goal: direct response. I will attach campaign, search-term, placements, and GA4 exports.

prompt_templates.title: Waste and Measurement Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Meta account for wasted spend and measurement issues. Goal: prospecting. Use the attached campaign export, placements report, and GA4 data.

prompt_templates.title: Full RQS Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full ROAS RQS audit. State the goal column, check R1/R2/O1/O2/A1, compute the capped score, and give a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdict.

prompt_templates.title: Auditor Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an auditor handoff for this account. Include key findings, evidence summary, open inputs, top fixes, and the recommended next workflow.

output_examples.input: Campaign and GA4 exports before a direct-response budget increase.
output: Verdict: FIX because tracking is reliable but wasted spend is high.
The report highlights weak search-term controls, poor pacing, and specific budget changes to make before scaling.

output_examples.input: Search terms, placements, and ecommerce data for a prospecting account.
output_examples.output: The audit flags unsafe placements, missing exclusions, and possible duplicate attribution. It recommends blocking scale until placement safety and attribution are fixed.

output_examples.input: Pre-launch Google Ads account with no placements report.
output_examples.output: The audit asks for the missing placements export, marks placement safety as unresolved, and gives a no-go launch decision.

best_practices: Attach campaign, search-term, placements, and GA4 or ecommerce exports when possible.
State whether the goal is direct response or prospecting before scoring begins.
Review saved audit artifacts and remove sensitive account identifiers before sharing results.
anti_patterns: Do not paste platform secrets, API keys, or login tokens into the audit.
Do not treat missing conversion or placement data as a pass.
Do not use the score as the only basis for legal or policy decisions.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It works best with campaign, search-term, placements, GA4, and ecommerce exports from your own account.

faq.question: Can it connect directly to ad platforms?
faq.answer: The skill is designed for manual exports. Optional connectors may help, but keyed APIs are not required.

faq.question: What does SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK mean?
faq.answer: SHIP means scale can proceed. FIX means issues need work. BLOCK means serious vetoes should stop scaling.

faq.question: Does it calculate real ROAS?
faq.answer: It scores ROAS quality and readiness. It also uses exported revenue and conversion evidence when available.

faq.question: Can it audit missing data?
faq.answer: It can note missing inputs, but it cannot verify tracking, attribution, or placements without supporting exports.

faq.question: Is this a compliance review?
faq.answer: No. It can flag claim and platform-policy risks, but legal and policy specialists should review high-risk issues.
